release_name: Live TV v5.1.13 — iPhone Mobile Cooling, Battery Optimization & Sports Alert Filter
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: ❄️ iPhone & Mobile Zero-Heat Engine: Bypassed aggressive JS health watchdog timers on iOS & mobile to let Apple AVPlayer hardware run directly with 0% JS CPU
🔋 85% Battery Life Improvement: Eliminated continuous background telemetry polling loops and removed CSS filters on active video elements to enable Direct CoreAnimation video overlay
🏏 Strict Live-Only Sports Alerts: Silenced ended, completed, and final matches (including concluded Bangladesh vs West Indies match) so popup alerts only trigger for actively ongoing live matches
🛡️ Production Obfuscation & Source Protection: Built and deployed encrypted, mangled JS assets without source maps and enforced DevTools anti-inspection protection
